paragraph1: VoiceBridge is an Augmentative and Alternative Communication (AAC) app for families and therapy centers supporting non-verbal people of determination. It is simple enough for a child to use independently, and structured enough for professionals to manage several clients from one dashboard.
paragraph2: Parents and caregivers receive real-time notifications the moment their child communicates — creating a genuine, continuous communication loop throughout the day.

1.title: Child taps a card
1.desc: A non-verbal child browses their personalized visual board and taps the card that expresses what they need.

2.title: Card speaks aloud
2.desc: The app speaks the phrase using text-to-speech with the child's name — reinforcing communication and identity.

3.title: Parent is notified
3.desc: A real-time push notification reaches the parent or caregiver instantly, wherever they are.

stats.didYouKnowText: Research shows that AAC tools can dramatically improve communication outcomes for non-verbal children, often unlocking the ability to express needs they couldn't before.
